lyrics.text:

A broom that knew the corners of the place

songs.title: Jihad at the Holy Big Top

lyrics.text:

Roll up the canvas, tighten the wire

Where the battered horns and the wild hearts go

The sword was tin, the tyrants fled the floor
Tony locked the ledger and opened every door

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
Three years dry on a barroom stool
Drinking ginger ale and keeping cool
Geglash came in from the pouring rain
Just to hear the old jukebox complain

[Verse 1]
He'd been stout-hearted, standing tall
Never missed the morning after at all
Knew every bottle by its old first name
But quit returning when temptation came
Then the barman raised a midnight brew
Black as a boot with a collar of dew

San Francisco, midnight.
Tony got the roses.
Denny got a secret.
Chris-R got the stairs.
This is gonna hurt somebody.

[Verse 1]
Tony wore his smoky smile into the room,
Tommy stood there glowing in the candle gloom.
Football in a tuxedo, pictures on the wall,
Love was like a rooftop with no rail at all.
Lisa crossed the kitchen with a story in her eyes,
Mark kept every answer underneath a bad disguise.

[Pre-Chorus]
Denny said, “It’s nothing,” but his hands said more,

One touch, one debt, one dangerous spark,
Tommy in the doorway saying, “Oh, hi Mark.”

“Hold the line. Do not let go.”

Dropship gone, signal thin
Raynor shouting, “Bring her in!”
Static answered, cold and calm

You left me to the swarm
Under a blood-red storm
You sealed the doors and burned the map
While every warning cracked
You left me there alive
Where only monsters thrive
Remember my name when your empire learns
What comes back from the swarm

Hydralisk shadows crossed through the smoke
Zerglings rang on the barricade
I called command till the channel broke
And heard the choice that you had made
“Nothing personal”—that polished lie
From a throne not built quite yet
But betrayal has a longer life
Than the man who thinks it forgets

[Pre-Chorus]
Magazine low, visor split
No extraction, that was it
One green beacon faded black
Raynor swore he would come back

[Chorus]
You left me to the swarm
Under a blood-red storm
You sealed the doors and burned the map
While every warning cracked
You left me there alive
Where only monsters thrive
Remember my name when your empire learns
What comes back from the swarm

[Bridge]
Inside the noise, a deeper voice
No rank, no flag, no human choice
A thousand minds beneath my skin
Not an ending—a way in

I saw your fleet become a thread
I saw the crown above your head
Arcturus, sleep while engines hum
You made the blade that is to come

[Instrumental Break]

[Final Verse]
The platform vanished under claws
The woman fell, the signal died
But somewhere past the human laws
A darker heart opened its eyes
Jim, keep flying, keep your flame
There are debts the stars record
When I return, I won't be prey
And he won't be my lord

[Final Chorus]
